uiBuilder.label: Dynamic Component
uiBuilder.description: Renders another custom element by tag name and binds an arbitrary JSON object onto it as properties. Use when the target component isn't known until runtime.

properties.name: componentName
properties.label: Component Name
properties.description: Custom element tag name to render, e.g. 'now-button'.

properties.name: properties
properties.label: Properties
properties.description: JSON object of properties to set on the rendered component. Each key is set directly as a DOM property on the element.

properties.name: events
properties.label: Events
properties.description: JSON array of event names to forward from the rendered component as a single Dynamic Component Event (e.g. ["BUTTON_CLICKED"]). The rendered component (or a descendant inside its own shadow tree) must dispatch a CustomEvent with a matching type.

actions.name: DYNAMIC_COMPONENT_EVENT
actions.label: Dynamic Component Event
actions.description: Fired when the rendered component dispatches any event listed in Events. Use eventName to identify which event fired.

payload.name: eventName
payload.label: Event Name
payload.description: The name of the event fired by the rendered component.

payload.name: eventPayload
payload.label: Event Payload
payload.description: The original event's detail payload, or null if it had none.
